reason: This is a DSH plugin focused on processing and surfacing session token-usage data by scanning local session logs, exposing results through both a web sidebar UI and a `token_usage` agent tool; the README and package metadata consistently describe this as its core functionality.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中聚合并展示会话 token 用量，并提供 `token_usage` 工具支持 all/today/current 的查询。
summaries.en: This plugin aggregates and displays session token usage in DeepSeek Harness, with a web sidebar view plus a `token_usage` tool for all/today/current queries.

capabilities: reads local DSH session log files to aggregate token usage
exposes a `token_usage` tool with scoped queries
renders a web sidebar panel for token usage summaries and session detail

reasons.code: README states token counts are derived from `$DSH_HOME/sessions/**/session.jsonl(.zstd)` and aggregated by session logs, including per turn/step handling.
README documents an Agent tool `token_usage` with parameters `scope` and `includeSessions` for all/today/current usage queries in headless and Web sessions.
README describes a Web sidebar `Tokens` button/panel showing cumulative, today, and per-session input/output/cache token metrics and session details.

capabilities: reads local DSH session log files to aggregate token usage
exposes a `token_usage` tool with scoped queries
renders a web sidebar panel for token usage summaries and session detail
